note: These are fictional parser fixtures, not new clinical gold cases. The password fixture-only is public test data. Malformed inputs are literal invalid byte strings in tests, not modified source PDFs.

fixtures.purpose: native text, two columns, ruled table, adjacent-page report
fixtures.inspection: pdf-inspect reports two text pages; both rendered pages visually reviewed at 110 dpi.
pdf-inspect reports one page, no text, no fonts, and no images.

fixtures.purpose: nontext vector drawing, not a blank page
fixtures.inspection: pdf-inspect reports no text/images; rendered drawing visually reviewed at 72 dpi.

fixtures.purpose: rasterized fictional page with no native text
fixtures.inspection: pdf-inspect reports one image and no text; rendered page visually reviewed at 72 dpi.

fixtures.purpose: native header and rasterized content on the same page

pdf-merge tests/fixtures/pdf/native-layout.pdf tests/fixtures/pdf/image-only.pdf tests/fixtures/pdf/blank.pdf --pages tests/fixtures/pdf/native-layout.pdf:1 --out tests/fixtures/pdf/mixed-document.pdf

fixtures.purpose: native page plus explicitly inventoried blank page
fixtures.inspection: pdf-inspect confirms a native text page followed by a blank page.

fixtures.purpose: sticky-note amendment on a page with no native text
creation_commands: pdf-annotate add tests/fixtures/pdf/blank.pdf --out tests/fixtures/pdf/annotation-only.pdf --type note --page 1 --bbox 72,680,180,720 --text "FICTIONAL SOFTWARE TEST FIXTURE: amended measurement requires review." --author "Aira fixture author"
fixtures.inspection: pdf-inspect reports no native text; pdf-annotate list confirms a Text annotation; rendered note icon visually reviewed at 110 dpi.

fixtures.purpose: visible strikeout amendment on a native text page
creation_commands: pdf-annotate add tests/fixtures/pdf/native-layout.pdf --out tests/fixtures/pdf/native-with-annotation.pdf --type strike --page 1 --bbox 195,568,250,586 --text "FICTIONAL SOFTWARE TEST FIXTURE: this measurement is withdrawn." --author "Aira fixture author"
fixtures.inspection: pdf-inspect confirms two native pages; pdf-annotate list confirms a StrikeOut annotation; red strikeout over the value area visually reviewed at 110 dpi.
